name: design-skills
description: Design-domain skills across three vintages. Crossing-axis DECOMPOSERS: layout-decomposer (UI layout on OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT + a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library), mermaid-decomposer (advanced Mermaid on INTENT x RENDER + an 11-type catalog + a mechanized render-check), component-decomposer (a zero-dependency web component AND how components compose — nest/wire — up to the module, on COMPOSE x REALIZE + the (height-glyph)/2 geometry engine + contract & composition linters; hands the app shell up to layout-decomposer). REFERENCE skills: color-science (perceptual color + a TypeScript color library + 54 demos), typography-lettering (type anatomy → world scripts → the modern CSS text surface), ref-polyfills (CSS/JS feature support, polyfills/shims, feature-detection, the Baseline landscape). VERIFIERS: color-verifier, focus-verifier, i18n-verifier, perf-verifier, safety-verifier (gate a UI surface on contrast/CVD, focus order, internationalization, performance budgets, and safety). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
